mineral_product.label: Mineral / product
mineral_product.value: Potash and potassium chloride, plus Trio (potassium, magnesium, sulfur), salt and water for agriculture, animal feed and oil and gas

extraction_route.label: Extraction route
extraction_route.value: Conventional underground potash mining in New Mexico and solar evaporation of brines in New Mexico and Utah

beneficiation_processing.label: Beneficiation / processing
beneficiation_processing.value: Solar evaporation crystallization, refining and flotation of potash and langbeinite into finished fertilizer and feed products

delivery_radius_logistics.label: Delivery radius / logistics
delivery_radius_logistics.value: Rail and truck shipments to US domestic agriculture, animal feed and industrial customers; water delivered to oil and gas operators in the Permian

product_specification_permits.label: Product specification / permits
product_specification_permits.value: High quality potassium, magnesium and sulfur fertilizer and feed products, delivered on time and in full

notes: Extraction, reserves, processing and logistics come from general knowledge of Intrepid, not the evidence.
